elements_selected.content:
Upgrade the existing Cmd+K search modal in the serve mode HTML (src/web/html.rs or the base template if IMPL-012 has landed) to query /api/search instead of filtering the sidebar page list. Current behavior: The Cmd+K modal filters a pre-built JSON array of page names client-side (fuzzy match on name only). New behavior per REQ-013-013: 1. On keyup in the search input, debounce 150ms, then fetch GET /api/search?q=&limit=20. 2. Display results showing: page name, heading (if present), context snippet, and BM25 score. 3. Keyboard navigation: arrow keys to move between results, Enter to navigate to the selected page. 4. Show a loading indicator while the fetch is in flight. 5. Clear results when input is cleared. The existing page-name fuzzy filter can be kept as a fast fallback for very short queries (≤2 chars) or shown while waiting for the API response. Result display format:
Page Name ## Heading ...matching context... 8.72
REQ-013-013.
Modified 5 files (+99, -344): .hence/context-manifest.json, src/cli.rs, src/main.rs, src/search.rs, tests/integration.rs
